Observations are station-level measurements, not provincial aggregates; publication must keep spatial_support=station.
Where the provider does not officially confirm a unit, the publication keeps unit=null with unit_status=pending_official_confirmation.
Every display must carry the credit "ข้อมูลตรวจวัดอากาศรายสถานี โดย กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา (Thai Meteorological Department)".
